notes.title: Flash Snooker Game update (1.9.055)
notes.notes: Latest version of Flash Snooker 1.9.055. New Daily Challenges with Prizes. Play the best online snooker game ever! Realistic physics, Fun and Quick gameplay, Rankings, Tournaments, lots of stats, Cues and more! - Includes Fix for missing chest SFX.

notes.title: Flash Snooker 1.9.05 Latest Update
notes.notes: Latest version of Flash Snooker introduces new daily practice challenges. Try these and see how you compare against other players and win Prizes. Chat IM (instant message) system has also been improved as well as further performance upgrades to server and client. Play the best online snooker game ever and challenge your friends now. Free to play!

notes.title: Update notes for Dec 20th 2023 - Flash Snooker 1.9.04
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New Daily Challenge feature for all users (prizes coming soon). 
[*] Server performance and login name fix for usernames with extended characters. This prevents intermittent server freezing / lag. 
[*] Improved Settings layout with cleaned up font and alignment
[*] Optimized server code (reduced data required for accounts)
[*] Client code optimized for slgihtly improved performance
[/list]

notes.title: Flash Snooker 1.9.01
notes.notes:
Includes Updates from 1.9.00 and fixed folder installation structure. Challenge your friends to the most realistic and fun game of online snooker now!

* Performance improvements and Bug Fixes

notes.title: Flash Snooker 1.9.00 - Improved performance and bug fixes
notes.notes:
This is the first of many planned updates which provides compatibility with the latest server (1.9.00). 
* Server and Client performance improvements
* New Admin Controls (allows us to adjust player ratings live)
* Bug fix for Chat IM dialog for incorrect layer when returning to lobby from table
* Fixed a number of server issues which causes intermittent freezing / slow down
